lineas.texto: Your injectables clients research for weeks. Then they book whoever answers their questions first.
This is what injectables website design should look like in 2026.
Botox clients come back every few months. Does your website remind them?
Injectables website design isn't about pretty photos. It's about answering fears before the consultation.
Each treatment gets its own page: what it is, how long it lasts, what it costs, and a book a free consult button.
Behind it, a simple client system: it keeps each patient's treatment history and texts them when it's time for their next appointment. That's repeat revenue on autopilot.
